notes.title: Sword Princess Amaltea Release Update
notes.notes:
It is finally time to reveal the release date for our upcoming launch:

[b]Sword Princess Amaltea - The Visual Novel will release on the 21st of October 2021![/b]

Be sure to add it to your wishlist so not to miss the release date! We would like to thank you all for your support and encouragement during this development process.
